messages.subject: RHEL/Centos 64bit compile hint
parts:
I just wanted to let folks know that there is a problem with libapreq2
that comes bundled with the rapache module source. By default it
assumes a /usr/lib directory on the ld path. If you happen to be
running a 64bit OS your libs are probably under /usr/lib64 instead.
Before running ./configure you can execute the following to add the
correct lib path to ld:

LDFLAGS=-L/usr/lib64

This bit me for a little bit while I traced why it was attempting to
use the 32bit libs.

-Erik
